UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Vietnam: The intrepid 'ancient mariners' go on one last far-flung voyage to southeast Asia, travelling the waterways of Vietnam from Halong Bay to Ninh Binh, Hoa Lu and Hanoi. S6 Ep7

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Great Canal Journeys
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Vietnam and Cambodia: Timothy West and Prunella Scales' final journey takes them to Cambodia, where they finish their travels at Angkor Wat, a temple built by the clever use of canals. S6 Ep8

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Michael Palin: Travels of a Lifetime
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: A look back at how Michael first became an accidental traveller after accepting an offer to go around the world in 80 days, following the route in the classic Jules Verne story. S1 Ep1

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Train Rescue Down Under
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: The Stakes Are High: In Perth, the pressure is on for a team tackling a high-stakes engine rebuild, and in Townsville, a crew of experts build a massive underframe for a freight powerhouse. S1 Ep3

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Flipping Bangers
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Citroen XM: Gus has his eye on a Citroen XM that looks amazing - but it's in France. Will isn't sure, but the engineering challenges win him over. S2 Ep12

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Flipping Bangers
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Audi TT: Gus and Will find an Audi Quattro roadster than has seen better days - it's full of problems, and hasn't been serviced in years. Even so, they are intent on renovating it. S2 Ep13

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Canal Boat Diaries
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Simpson to Little Tring: During a cold snap Robbie Cumming gets iced in on the Grand Union Canal. Later, his parents pay a visit and help him through Marsworth Locks. S5 Ep10

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Canal Boat Diaries
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Napton Junction to Aynho Wharf: Robbie Cumming navigates the scenic Oxford Canal onboard Naughty Lass, explores its twists and turns, and helps tow a stranded broken-down boater. S6 Ep1

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Saving Lives at Sea
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: 999: In Dungeness, the crew are called out to a small boat in the middle of the shipping lanes - and discover the casualty is the subject of a major manhunt. S9 Ep2

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Blue Planet II
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Coral Reefs: Creatures that live on coral reefs, including groupers, predators with a grasp of communication that has led scientists to conclude they're as intelligent as chimpanzees. S2 Ep3

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Blue Planet II
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Big Blue: Wildlife that live thousands of kilometres from land, featuring footage of baby turtles using debris as life rafts and sperm whales hunting for squid deep beneath the surface. S2 Ep4

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: The Two Mercs/Fiesta ST: This week tells the tale of the two Mercs, but what will the moral of the story be? Plus, the team get stuck into a moddable favourite - a 2006 Ford Fiesta ST. S8 Ep3

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Mercedes 380SL, Vauxhall, Talbot Sunbeam Lotus: Derek is reunited with a restored Mercedes SL, Paul picks up a historic rally car, and a 1974 Vauxhall VX sells for a pricey sum. S14 Ep12

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Classic Car Kings
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: VW Type 1 Beetle: Big Irv has had a life-long love affair with VWs, so he's extremely surprised when he's offered the chance to work on a very early 1949 Beetle. S1 Ep1

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: 1999 Morgan/Monkey Bike: The guys are drawn by the curves of a stunning 1999 Morgan with an incredible 4.6 V8 engine, but things aren't as good as they seem when they get to the garage. S8 Ep4
